description: This file defines adapter classes for WebSocket streams to interface with TCP/TLS sockets, HTTP/2 streams, and HTTP/3 streams within the Chromium networking code. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and delegate interfaces for handling WebSocket stream operations and stream lifecycle events.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use a TCP/IP or TLS socket handle.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/2 stream, forwarding headers and data events.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/3 (QUIC) stream, handling headers and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for forwarding stream delegate events related to headers and closure.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for forwarding QUIC stream events related to headers and closure.

methods.description: Checks if the adapter is initialized.
